difficulty_reason: Equivalence of semistable reduction of the generic fibre with existence of a stable model over R: (2) implies (1) since a stable family of curves is in particular prestable; conversely the prestable family over R with generic fibre C is contracted to a stable family by the chapter's contraction lemma, the generic fibre being already stable and hence unchanged by the contraction. Retained author proof at lines 3258-3265.
